$comment: Seed data for airports and tower-hour schedules. Insert-only: rows whose id already exists in the live database are never modified by this file. Edit online at /admin/airports and use Export JSON to refresh this file. Hours are local 24h; open/close null = no tower for that period; 'to' null = open-ended.

schedules.note: Hours from the FAA Chart Supplement (AirNav), Aug 2026. Tower 0700–2230; rounded to 22:00 (the half hour is counted as closed).

Reference airport, not a dark tower. The tower is staffed 24 hours; these hours mark the Burbank-Glendale-Pasadena Airport Authority's voluntary curfew, 10:00 pm to 7:00 am local, when takeoffs and landings by noisy aircraft are to stop. The Authority reports over 99% compliance and allows exceptions for emergencies, weather alternates and air traffic control delays. The curfew is a voluntary agreement, not a federal rule: the Authority's Part 161 request for a mandatory curfew was denied in November 2009. Sources: hollywoodburbankairport.com/noise/voluntary-curfew and /noise/noise-issues, checked September 2026.
